title: Grand Theft Auto VI exists in its own universe
summary: Grand Theft Auto VI was revealed through 90 leaked videos four years ago, showcasing Rockstar's next-generation open-world game set in Vice City with new dual protagonists. The comprehensive leak provided extensive details about the game's crime-focused gameplay and design mechanics. The reveal has significantly shaped anticipation for one of gaming's most awaited titles.
content:
This is The Stepback, a weekly newsletter breaking down one essential story from the tech world. For more on GTA VI and the state of the video game industry, follow Andrew Webster. The Stepback arrives in our subscribers' inboxes at 8AM ET. Opt in for The Stepback here.
How it started
Four years ago, fans got a long-awaited look at Grand Theft Auto VI with a huge cache of videos that showed off Rockstar's latest open-world epic. There were 90 videos in total, providing a glimpse at the next-generation take on Vice City, introducing the game's new dual protagonists, and generally showing off the crime-fueled mayhem the series is known for.  …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 侠盗猎车手VI存在于自己的宇宙中
zh.summary: 侠盗猎车手VI在四年前通过90个泄露视频被曝光，展示了Rockstar的次世代开放世界游戏，背景设定在Vice City，并推出了新的双主角。这次全面的泄露详细披露了该游戏以犯罪为中心的游戏机制和设计细节。这一曝光大大增强了人们对这款游戏界最受期待的作品之一的期待。

title: Volcanoes that made history
summary: The article examines major volcanic eruptions throughout history that fundamentally altered Earth's climate and reshaped societies across the globe. These catastrophic eruptions demonstrate how natural phenomena can dramatically impact human civilizations and planetary environmental conditions. Historical analysis of such events provides crucial insights into climate dynamics and societal resilience.
content: Enormous eruptions altered Earth’s climate and societies all over the globe.

zh.title: 塑造历史的火山
zh.summary: 该文章研究了历史上重大火山爆发事件，这些爆发从根本上改变了地球气候，重塑了全球社会。这些灾难性的火山喷发表明了自然现象对人类文明和地球环境条件的巨大影响。对这些历史事件的分析为了解气候动态和社会抗压能力提供了关键的见解。

title: Two years after launch, Walmart’s Flipkart is closing in on India’s quick-commerce leaders
summary: Walmart-backed Flipkart's quick-commerce platform is processing 1.1 to 1.2 million orders per day, nearly triple its volume from November. The rapid growth demonstrates Flipkart's competitive positioning as it challenges established quick-commerce leaders in India's fast-growing delivery market.
content: Flipkart's quick-commerce venture is delivering 1.1 million to 1.2 million orders a day, nearly triple its November volume.

zh.title: 推出两年后，沃尔玛的Flipkart逼近印度快商领导者
zh.summary: 沃尔玛支持的Flipkart快商平台每天处理110万至120万订单，相比11月份增长近三倍。这一快速增长展示了Flipkart在印度快速增长的配送市场中的竞争地位，挑战着现有的快商领导者。
